method.timer: performance.now() around parse() only; bytes already in memory; a fresh copy of the bytes per run, made outside the timed span
method.gcBetweenRuns: gc() (--expose-gc) before every run, outside the timed span
method.isolation: fresh browser context and page per (file, entrant)
method.order: entrants in a seeded random order per file (mulberry32, seed 20261011)
method.memory: approximate: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize just before and just after the last timed parse (model retained), plus wasm linear memory size for wasm entrants; not a peak measurement

entrants.name: Nitro XML (Rust/WASM)
entrants.version: 0.0.0 (workspace nitro-xml-xlsx / nitro-xml-docx / nitro-xml-pptx, path-dep from rs/crates/)

fastestConfig.xlsx: load_workbook_meta(bytes) then parse_all_worksheets(bytes, &wb). Built wasm32-unknown-unknown release, opt-level 3, LTO, codegen-units 1, wasm-opt -O3
fastestConfig.docx: read_package(bytes). Built wasm32-unknown-unknown release, opt-level 3, LTO, codegen-units 1, wasm-opt -O3
fastestConfig.pptx: Presentation::open(bytes) then ensure_all_slides(). Built wasm32-unknown-unknown release, opt-level 3, LTO, codegen-units 1, wasm-opt -O3

entrants.name: upstream ooxml TS (ChristopherVR/ooxml, ooxml-core)
entrants.version: git e66aaec24adc0b68472eae1fc42aa4598e09c352 (ooxml-core 1.8.2), built from the upstream/ submodule

fastestConfig.xlsx: loadWorkbook(bytes) from ooxml-core/xlsx/load, the call the upstream Excel UI makes (src/ui/src/xlsx/editor-files.ts)
fastestConfig.docx: loadDocument(bytes) from ooxml-core/docx/load, the call the upstream Word UI makes (src/ui/src/docx/component.ts)
fastestConfig.pptx: new PptxHandler().load(arrayBuffer) from ooxml-core/pptx, as the upstream PowerPoint viewer does (viewers/pptx/packages/angular/src/viewer/load-content.service.ts)

fastestConfig.setting: XLSX.read(bytes, { type: 'array', dense: true, cellText: false, cellFormula: false, cellHTML: false, cellStyles: false })
fastestConfig.why: dense mode is the documented faster/lower-memory sheet layout; cellText/cellFormula/cellHTML skip formatted text, formulae and rich-text HTML, none of which the parse race's equivalence output (value + type) needs
the documented browser reader; the faster streaming WorkbookReader needs Node streams and files and is not available in a browser

fastestConfig.setting: Xlsx::new(Cursor::new(bytes)) then Reader::worksheets() (all sheet ranges into memory); default features (no chrono). Built wasm32-unknown-unknown release, opt-level 3, LTO, codegen-units 1, wasm-opt -O3
fastestConfig.why: calamine is lazy per sheet; worksheets() is the documented call that reads every sheet's values, which the equivalence check needs

fastestConfig.setting: reader::xlsx::read_reader(Cursor::new(bytes), true). Built wasm32-unknown-unknown release, opt-level 3, LTO, codegen-units 1, wasm-opt -O3; getrandom 0.4 'wasm_js' feature enabled (its documented wasm32 backend, pulled in via rand)
fastestConfig.why: the full reader; lazy_read leaves sheets undeserialised, so it would not yield the cell values the equivalence check needs

fastestConfig.setting: parseAsync(bytes, {}) (the parse half of renderAsync; parsing does not consult the render options)

fastestConfig.why: its cheapest public API that yields all body text; there is no public parse-only API, so the timed span also produces the text string (cheap compared with convertToHtml)

fastestConfig.setting: read_docx(bytes). Built wasm32-unknown-unknown release, opt-level 3, LTO, codegen-units 1, wasm-opt -O3
parseDocx(bytes, { preloadFonts: false, parseHeadersFooters: false, parseNotes: false }) — opc+parse wasm only; layout/edit wasm unused
fastestConfig.why: documented headless parse API; skipping fonts/headers/notes is the cheapest path that still yields the body paragraph model the equivalence check needs

entrants.name: PPTXjs
entrants.version: v1.21.1 = git 1a9260b2062f89ba822aeb54da792236780af8e7 (not published on npm; files fetched from GitHub and sha256-verified by build.mjs)
entrants.timingScope: parse + HTML generation + DOM insertion (no parse-only API)

fastestConfig.setting: $(host).pptxToHtml({ pptxFileUrl: <blob: URL of the in-memory bytes>, mediaProcess: false, slideMode: false })
fastestConfig.why: its only public API; it parses and generates and inserts the slides' HTML in one synchronous pass, so its parse-race time includes HTML generation and DOM insertion (more work than a parse: flagged on the page). mediaProcess:false is a documented option that skips audio/video extraction and does not change text

entrants.name: LibreOffice WASM (ZetaOffice / LOWA)
entrants.reason: not entered: the documented binaries are only published under the unversioned path zetaoffice_latest (cannot be pinned, which the fairness rules require), they are about 53 MB (soffice.wasm 36.3 MB + soffice.data 15.9 MB + soffice.js 0.9 MB) and need a cross-origin-isolated threaded page, and LibreOffice has no parse-only boundary: loadComponentFromURL imports and lays out the document into the Writer/Calc/Impress model, so a parse-race number would not measure the same work. Building a pinned LOWA from source was not feasible in this run. Revisit for the render-to-first-paint race with a self-built, pinned LOWA.

evaluated.name: @silurus/ooxml (yukiyokotani/office-open-xml-viewer)
evaluated.language: Rust parsers compiled to WASM + TypeScript Canvas renderers
evaluated.upkeep: very active (last commit 2026-10-11); README states the whole codebase is written by AI coding agents
evaluated.assessment: docx/xlsx/pptx viewer (17 MB unpacked). Public API is viewer classes (DocxViewer, ...) that parse and paint; candidate for the render-to-first-paint race, not entered in the parse race because no documented parse-only API with a cell/text model was found.

evaluated.name: shrimp-doc-viewer (cjo4m06/shrimp-doc-viewer)
evaluated.licence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (licence files in the npm package; the GitHub repo has no detected licence)
evaluated.assessment: viewer-only (renderDocxInto, XlsxViewer, ...); no parse-only API. Candidate for first-paint only; low upkeep.

evaluated.name: OpenOOXML/BetterOffice (openooxml/betteroffice)
evaluated.assessment: @betteroffice/docx entered in the docx parse race (see entrants.betteroffice-docx). Layout/edit wasm and xlsx/pptx packages remain out of scope for this slice.

evaluated.name: pptx-preview
evaluated.upkeep: last publish 2025-10-17; npm lists no source repository
evaluated.assessment: renderer only (init(el).preview(arrayBuffer)), minified dist without a public repo; no parse-only API. Candidate for first paint only.
